entries.title: Notes on a card are quicker to start, keep and send
entries.body: Selecting words in a card now shows a small Annotate button and leaves Copy alone; click it or press Enter to start a note with the cursor already in its comment. Clicking away keeps what you typed as a queued note, clicking a note's underlined words opens it again with Remove beside Cancel and Queue, and while notes wait the send button reads Send 2 notes.

picture.alt: A card with two queued notes underlined in its text, one note reopened from its words showing its comment with Remove, Cancel and Queue, and the thread's send button reading Send 2 notes
